candidates.formal_type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} V] [inst_1 : Module.{0, u_1} Complex V]
  [FiniteDimensional.{0, u_1} Complex V] (A : Module.End.{0, u_1} Complex V),
  IsNilpotent.{u_1} A →
    And (Exists.{u_1 + 1} fun ρ => Eq.{u_1 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, 1, u_1 + 1} ρ Etingof.Sl2Irrep.sl2_e) A)
      (∀
        (ρ ρ' :
          LieHom.{0, 0, u_1} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x)
            (Module.End.{0, u_1} Complex V)),
        Eq.{u_1 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, 1, u_1 + 1} ρ Etingof.Sl2Irrep.sl2_e) A →
          Eq.{u_1 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, 1, u_1 + 1} ρ' Etingof.Sl2Irrep.sl2_e) A →
            Nonempty.{u_1 + 1}
              (LieModuleEquiv.{0, 0, u_1, u_1} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x)
                (Etingof.Sl2Irrep.RepOf.{u_1} ρ) (Etingof.Sl2Irrep.RepOf.{u_1} ρ')))

source_text: Part (l): a nilpotent operator A is the raising operator of an sl(2)-representation, unique up to module isomorphism.
